u0: Initial state: the ball still blocks the door cell, the agent holds no door key, and the door is closed. Next objective: move the ball off the cell in front of the door (pick it up) before acquiring the key. Picking up the matching key first would bring a penalty and put progress at risk of key loss.
u1: The ball has been moved from in front of the door and the agent does not yet carry the matching key. Next objective: acquire the door key and carry it toward the door.
u2: The agent picked up the matching key before moving the ball, so the blocking ball is still in front of the door. Next objective: drop the key to free the hands and move the ball away; dropping the key while the door is closed loses the key and sends progress back to the ball-moved-only condition.
u3: The agent carries the matching door key with the ball moved aside. Next objective: reach the door cell and toggle it to unlock and open it. Losing the key before opening resets progress to the ball-moved-only condition.
u4: The door is open and the agent is through or can pass into the box room; the key need not be retained. Next objective: locate the mission-designated box and pick it up.
u5: Terminal success: the agent has picked up the mission's target box, earning the final reward. No further action is needed.
